definitions.explanation: One example among many; a single illustrative case. Used in writing and presentation to introduce a specific instance that demonstrates a broader pattern.

examples.japanese: {一例|いちれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{一例|いちれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: This is just one example among many.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一例|いちれい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As one example of a successful case, his company was introduced.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (example). Slightly more formal than just ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧, with the nuance of "just one of many." Often used in writing to soften a single example into something representative rather than exhaustive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一例|いちれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to give an example
- {一例|いちれい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as one example
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{一例|いちれい}: just one example (often "merely one example among many")
- {一例|いちれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: is only one example

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧: example — the everyday word, no "just one" nuance
- ⟦{具体例|ぐたいれい}→具体例：14760_gutairei⟧: concrete example — emphasizes specificity
- ⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧: case (study); instance — used for documented examples in research/reports
